recap.text: Mistress Tiatha is the tutorial guide for the Meadow Lark group. Her crawlers share her rules that every borough and city boss holds a stairwell for the first four or five floors. Mistress Tiatha tells her crawlers the second floor lasts ten days, but the countdown resets to six.

Elle McGibbons files a report on her manager, Mistress Tiatha. Tiatha treats the post like a spring break, drinking, smoking blitz sticks, and crying about a space pony. She takes gold from Elle for booze and suggests her crawlers blow the room up like Carl.

Mordecai holds that a boss cannot be charmed, but the subject insists she has done it. Rules state a white-tagged boss can be charmed if the crawler clears it by a hundred points. This puts the subject on the right side of the argument and the cat, at one hundred and one points over, on the right side of the arithmetic by one.
Orren explains who is taking the show away from its showrunners. Mistress Tiatha turns her empty bottle upside down and announces she needs another drink.

Mistress Tiatha, drunk, listens to Tipid describe the Crawler Project wins of citizenship, healthcare, and housing. She grunts with derision and says those perks are only for new crawlers. She takes a long swig, looks at Mongo with wet eyes, and wanders off.

beats.headline: Our tutorial guide lady
beats.text: Subject is the tutorial guide assigned to the Meadow Lark group. Her crawlers pass her rules on to anyone who will listen: every borough and city boss holds a stairwell for the first four or five floors, and there are other stairs in random places besides.
beats.gist: Mistress Tiatha is the tutorial guide for the Meadow Lark group.

beats.headline: Ten days, she said
beats.text: Subject told her crawlers the second floor would last ten days. The countdown resets to six. Her crawlers note the difference.
beats.gist: Mistress Tiatha tells crawlers the second floor lasts ten days, but the countdown resets to six.

beats.headline: A manager on spring break
beats.text: Report filed by her crawler Elle McGibbons. Subject was very excited to become Meadow Lark's manager and is treating the post like a spring break. She spends most of the day drinking and smoking blitz sticks, cries about her space pony, or whatever it was, from her own time in the dungeon, and takes gold from Elle to buy more booze. She does throw out a suggestion every once in a while. One of them is that her crawlers pull a Carl and blow the room up.
beats.gist: Elle McGibbons reports Mistress Tiatha drinks, smokes blitz sticks, cries about a space pony, and takes gold.

beats.headline: She has charmed a boss
beats.text: Mordecai holds that a boss cannot be charmed. Subject insists she has done it. The rules say a white-tagged boss can be, if the crawler clears it by a hundred points, which puts her on the right side of the argument, and puts the cat, at a hundred and one points over, on the right side of the arithmetic by one.
beats.gist: Mistress Tiatha charms a white-tagged boss by clearing it by a hundred points.

beats.headline: Another drink
beats.text: Orren explains who is taking the show away from its showrunners. Subject turns her empty bottle upside down and announces that she needs another drink, which is the most reasonable response anyone in the room has.
beats.gist: Orren explains who takes the show from its showrunners, and Mistress Tiatha asks for another drink.

beats.headline: Only for new crawlers
beats.text: Subject, drunk as usual, listens to Tipid describe what the Crawler Project won, citizenship, healthcare and housing for released crawlers, and grunts with derision. That perk is only for new crawlers, she says, and they will still be bled dry on taxes. The old guard will be extra fucked on release. The rich like their faces on screen while they donate, and they will fight like hell when a scruffy former crawler tries to settle in their system. She takes a long swig, looks at Mongo with wet eyes, and wanders off.
beats.gist: Drunk Mistress Tiatha grunts with derision at Tipid's description of citizenship, healthcare, and housing for crawlers.
